title: H^n-null sets on which μ has finite density are μ-null
statement: Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N and Z ⊆ ℝ^N with H^n(Z) = 0 such that at every x ∈ Z the n-density of μ exists and is finite (HasDensity n μ x θ for some θ ∈ [0, ∞)). Then μ(Z) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (Z : Set (Euclidean N)), μHE[n] Z = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, θ ≠ ∞ ∧ HasDensity n μ x θ) → μ Z = 0
